name: A ship with no AIS says so, and the vessel card draws the anchor chain (signed in)
description: Validates the edge where no AIS report survives (Eagle S: every position placed from statements) and the side profile in the vessel card opened on the ship.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-ship-03+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024?t=2024-12-25T10:30Z&mode=ship and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"

Scroll the panel on the right of the 3D view until the card "AIS signal" (data-testid ais-signal) is in view (click "Show panel" first if it is folded), then assert the card "AIS signal" (data-testid ais-signal) has data-state "no-ais" and data-report-count "0", says "No AIS report survives for this ship in this case.", and shows a dashed stretch (data-testid ais-reconstructed) with data-state "reconstructed"

Assert the ship card (data-testid ship-card) lists "Cook Islands", "IMO 9329760" and "MMSI 518998865", and the side profile (data-testid vessel-profile) has data-state "dragging" and data-chain-out-metres "330"

Click "Replay" in the mode switch (data-testid mode-switch), then click the ship's name "Eagle S" (data-testid open-vessel-card) in the panel on the right of the 3D view (click "Show panel" first if it is folded)

Assert the vessel card (data-testid vessel-card) opens with "Oil tanker, 228.6 m, Cook Islands flag", contains a side profile (data-testid vessel-profile) whose text includes "chain out 330 m", and still says "Between two placed positions"
